paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира връзката между грешката (RTE) и ранга на QLoRA теглата. 

Оста X е обозначена като "Rank" и има логаритмична скала. Диапазонът на стойностите е от 4 до 256, като единиците са безразмерни. Етикетите са разположени при 4, 16, 64 и 256.

Оста Y е обозначена като "Error (RTE)" и има линейна скала. Диапазонът на стойностите е от 0.3 до 0.9, като единиците са безразмерни. Етикетите са разположени при 0.3, 0.6 и 0.9.

Графиката показва една линия, която е черна и плътна. Тя преминава през четири зелени точки с черни вертикални линии за грешка. 

При ранг 4 стойността на грешката е около 0.58. При ранг 16 грешката намалява до около 0.48. При ранг 64 грешката се увеличава леко до около 0.49. При ранг 256 грешката се увеличава до около 0.63.
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the relationship between rank and error, specifically the error rate, measured in RTE. The x-axis, labeled "Rank," has a logarithmic scale with values ranging from 4 to 256, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of increasing magnitude, specifically 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis, labeled with values but no explicit title, has a linear scale with values from 0.3 to 0.9, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.3. The plot features a single black line with green circular markers, connected by solid line segments. Starting from the left, at a rank of 4, the line begins at approximately 0.55; it then decreases to around 0.45 at a rank of 16, remains relatively stable at about 0.45 at a rank of 64, and finally increases to approximately 0.65 at a rank of 256. Vertical error bars are present for each data point.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den empirischen Verallgemeinerungsfehler in Relation zum Rang von QLoRA-Gewichten. Die x-Achse ist logarithmisch skaliert und zeigt den Rang, mit Werten von 4 bis 256. Die y-Achse zeigt den Fehler (RTE) mit Werten von 0,3 bis 0,9. Die Linie im Diagramm ist schwarz und durchgezogen, mit grünen Punkten als Markierungen. Zu Beginn, bei einem Rang von 4, liegt der Fehler bei etwa 0,6. Er nimmt leicht ab auf etwa 0,5 bei einem Rang von 16, bleibt bei einem Rang von 64 ungefähr gleich und steigt dann auf etwa 0,6 bei einem Rang von 256 an.
